en: Vintage colorized postcard showing a grand neoclassical building with a very long colonnaded façade and central portico, set against a backdrop of hills and a partly built-up city. The foreground includes streets, trees and open ground. Handwritten Greek text appears across the top, and printed text at the top left identifies the location. A watermark with a website address appears at the bottom right.
